notes.title: NEW UPDATE #3
notes.notes: We have more transformations based on item synergy, more items dropping, more fun and a complete game, have fun roguelike hunters!!!

notes.title: NEW UPDATE 2.0
notes.notes: Now we have seven new special transformations based on item synergy, curious and very interesting transformations, I hope all fans of roguelikes and secrets have fun !!!

notes.title: NEW UPDATE 1.1
notes.notes:
In this New Update, we have 40+ new relics and the possibility of transforming physical forms, many more variations and fun for up to 4 players. 
coming soon: New Transformations based on relics synergy.

notes.title: NEW UPDATE 0.1
notes.notes: In this new Update we have new weapons and 3 new transformations and 3 new achievements. It is very important to have feedback and suggestions from all players, thanks to all players, the Ragmonton project is still going strong.
